evidence.note: Both: pin 1 VIN, pin 2 GND, pin 3 EN, pin 4 BP/BYP (bypass), pin 5 OUT.
TLV70033 VIN 2.0-5.5V; RT9193-33 VIN 2.3-5.5V. RT9193-33 has a slightly higher minimum VIN.
TLV70033 IOUT=200 mA; RT9193-33 IOUT=300 mA. RT9193-33 can supply more current than TLV70033 — safe direction for swap (300 mA part replacing 200 mA part), but verify the BP bypass cap value matches.
Both fixed 3.3V LDOs with active-high EN.
EN thresholds differ in detail; verify that the driving signal's logic level meets RT9193-33 VIH.
Both in SOT-23-5 with similar Rtheta_ja (~250 C/W). At 200 mA the dissipation is the same; both thermally equivalent.

conditions: Confirm the BP bypass capacitor value satisfies both datasheets (TLV700 typically 1 nF-0.1 uF, RT9193 specifies 0.01 uF-0.1 uF).
Confirm the EN driving signal VIH meets RT9193-33 requirement.
Confirm the input source never falls below RT9193-33's 2.3 V minimum.
verification_notes: Pin-compatible SOT-23-5 3.3V LDOs with overlapping specs. CONDITIONAL because the EN threshold and minimum VIN differ and must be checked on the specific board.
